top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises a genuinely new principle, small-molecule-induced proximity to an E3 ligase with catalytic removal of the target, reproduced independently for two decades. Handa's cereblon mechanism supplies the clinical validation that the PROTAC concept of Crews and Deshaies lacks, so the maturity objection is answered. Attribution is imperfect (Ito, Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim are left out) and the citation must be worded not to claim the whole field. The Ciulli trio P003 is a close second, then the cleanly credited C-N coupling pair P001, which is mature but close to the 2010 prize.
recusal_note: Postdoc with Arieh Warshel (EVB), and P004 (Car-Parrinello) lies in my own field of computational chemistry, so my placement of it should be discounted. No documented connection to any credited name in P001, P002 or P003; no recusal apparent.
